assessments.reasoning: The release notice identifies SAP and release 754. The introduction classifies ABAP as a language and explicitly places ABAP Objects within it as its object-oriented part. This establishes the documented language relationship within that edition.

challenge.method: Check whether ABAP Objects could be only an adjacent framework or a separate language covered by the same manual.
challenge.results: The introduction states the part-to-whole relationship directly and discusses frameworks and system classes separately. No inference from the manual’s title or table of contents is needed.

limitations: The proposed identity covers the documented SAP language. Runtime, development environment and cloud language restrictions are separately scoped.
